audit.whatIsWrong: The page attached the fear to the wrong ability throughout: focus.text, loading, breakdown.cooldowns, report[5].t and the trading bullets all call it 'Personal Space (Fear)'. Personal Space is the W — a shield with nearby damage. The fear belongs to the passive, Doom 'n Gloom. content spikes[1] also calls her ultimate 'Doom' and says it 'scales off missing HP', neither of which is true, and spikes[0] invented 'free instant-cast Mistral Bolt procs'.
audit.why: Riot's text: passive — 'Vex periodically becomes empowered, causing her next basic Ability to fear enemies and interrupt dashes. Whenever a nearby enemy dashes, Vex applies a mark that can be consumed for bonus damage that also reduces the cooldown of her empowered state.' W — 'Gain a shield and damage nearby enemies.' R (Shadow Surge) — 'Fire a missile that marks an enemy champion. Recast to dash to them and deal damage.' There is no missing-health scaling and no instant-cast proc; the mark is consumed by an ability for bonus damage and it accelerates her fear.
audit.corrected: focus.text, loading, breakdown.cooldowns, report[5].t, tradeBad, dosFull[0].d, dontsFull[0].d and the content spikes/early/mid now separate the three: Doom 'n Gloom is the fear that interrupts dashes, Personal Space is the 16s shield to force out before committing, Shadow Surge is the 2000-range mark plus recast dash.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phases[0..3], [5] and [6] read 'Skill' while content win[0..6] and the packet levelChart both read Vex on all seven rows — and every one of those full-layer whys described Aurora winning the stage.
audit.why: phases[N].side and win[N] are the same row. Packet and content agree on Vex x7, the 49.23% owner win rate and the TRICKY 7/10 label fit a lane Aurora is behind in, and the tldr already says the hop feeds her passive.
audit.corrected: All seven sides set to Vex, ratings raised to 7/10 to match the page's convention on the untouched Vex row, and every why rewritten in the same proposal to argue Vex's side with her own numbers (Q 1200 range and 8s to 4s, E flat 12s, W 16s shield, R 140s at rank 1).

audit.whatIsWrong: The early whys credited Aurora with winning levels 1 to 5 on a page whose own content layer gives every stage to Vex, and content early credited her poke to 'Q Twin Drift', a name in neither kit.
audit.why: Vex's early edge is concrete: Mistral Bolt is 1200 range against Aurora's 900 Q, it falls to 4 seconds by rank 5, and Looming Darkness is a flat 12s slow zone that sets up the Q. Aurora's dash is Across the Veil.
audit.corrected: Early whys and content early rebuilt on those numbers with the fabricated name removed.

audit.why: The numbers that decide this lane are Personal Space at 16s (the shield you must force out), Looming Darkness at a flat 12s, and Mistral Bolt going from 8s to 4s.
audit.corrected: All three stated, plus the passive rule that your own dash shortens her fear cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: Vex was called 'he/his' in nine fields (tradeGood, tradeBad, ahead, loading, phases[5].why, dosFull[0].t, dontsFull[0].t, dontsFull[1].t, report[11], report[13]).
audit.why: champ-gender.js lists vex as female, and the owner is addressed as 'you', so every third-person pronoun on the page is Vex.
audit.corrected: All edited fields use she/her. dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d, which were the tradeGood/tradeBad strings pasted under unrelated titles, were replaced with bodies matching their own titles.

audit.whatIsWrong: The shield was never treated as a burst problem anywhere on the page.
audit.why: missingInteractions rule 'shield-absorbs-burst': Personal Space absorbs the burst window, so an all-in launched into a fresh 16s shield does not have the damage it looks like it has.
audit.corrected: content mid, report[5].t, tradeBad and loading now say to force Personal Space out before committing.

notes: This page had the cleanest packet of the seven (no defects, no suspect names) and the worst mechanical mislabel: the whole matchup was built around 'Personal Space (Fear)', but Personal Space is the shield and the fear belongs to the passive, Doom 'n Gloom. I changed focus.text and loading together so the tracked-ability shorthand and the loading screen do not now disagree with breakdown.cooldowns and report[5]. The passive's own cooldown is not in the kit (it says only 'periodically becomes empowered' and that the dash-mark reduces it), so I described the glow as a state to read rather than quoting a timer. Riot's R text does not say the marked missile can be dodged or that the recast dash can be interrupted, so I asserted neither — only the 2000 range at rank 1 and the 140s cooldown. spikes[2] attributes a 'Liandry's-style burn' first-item spike to Vex; that is a build claim I could not source from the kits, so I left it.
